name: irpt-commentary-composition-read-lambda
invocation: direct invoke (lambda:InvokeFunction), RequestResponse; no API route, no CloudFront behavior, no event source
subject: svc-commentary (reports/repository.py SERVICE_READERS: family REQUEST_COMPOSITION only, read-only, bound to the request tenant)

request.refused_keys: any other key (principal, account_ids, firm_id, and the like) is refused by name

ok.composition: <the retained REQUEST_COMPOSITION document; the members that name its holder are removed and counted in redacted_count>
ok.sha256: <sha256 of the retained artifact, equal to composition_ref.sha256 on the READY item>

server_side: GetItem analysis#<request_id>#1 in the tenant partition (acceptance.DynamoAcceptance.get)
ArtifactRepository.get(service principal, artifact_id, data_firm=tenant) with its retention check kept
function_role_reads: dynamodb:GetItem on irpt-requests, leading keys = the served firms
s3:GetObject and GetObjectVersion on the REQUEST_COMPOSITION prefix of the served firms
kms:Decrypt via dynamodb and via s3 only
release_dependencies: attach the invoke policy from the transcripts root
~V2 amends svc-commentary's sign-off pair before the read deploys
